notes.title: Chapter 8 Complete – Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to share a status update on the development of the next season of With Eyes Closed. The eighth chapter is now complete, marking another step forward toward the full release of the new season.

────────────────────────── 

 

CHAPTER SUMMARY 

 

────────────────────────── 

 

• Key Teasers: Dive into emotional backstories, flirty games, protective missions, and steamy encounters with Luna, Harper, Kate, Olivia, and Barbara. Expect playful rivalries, deepening relationships, and a mix of tender and intense romantic/sexual moments. The chapter builds to a thrilling cliffhanger that sets up major conflicts ahead.

• A cozy start with Luna.

• An emotional chat with Kate about her past, deepening your bond.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514528/728e8ca5023df931460e63a3928c0b37d891a813.jpg"]

• A wild, escalating party game full of truths, dares, and surprises.

Content overview:

 

• 355 renders

 

• 16,000 words

 

• 33 animations



If you’d like more detailed updates and some behind-the-scenes insights, you can find them on my Patreon. However, all the main news and development progress will continue to be posted here on Steam as well.

Thank you for following the development progress. More updates will be posted here as work continues!

notes.title: Development Update: Chapter 7 Completed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
https://i.ibb.co/whd0cLN1/74-45.jpg
I wanted to share a status update on the development of the next season of With Eyes Closed. The seventh chapter is now complete, marking another step forward toward the full release of the new season.
https://i.ibb.co/wNs1tGLG/72-20.jpg
This chapter features a dangerous rescue mission, tense confrontations, and several key revelations that may challenge your trust in certain heroines. There are also new characters with their own motives and secrets, as well as opportunities for both passionate and tender romantic moments—depending on your choices. You’ll visit new locations, encounter heated arguments, and experience plenty of suspense as the story continues to unfold.
https://i.ibb.co/GfPJ6Ts0/73-23.jpg
Content of Chapter 7:

360 new renders
17,000 words
30 animations
https://i.ibb.co/1f8VJCfy/67-11.jpg
If you’d like more detailed updates and insights about the current status of the second season, you can find them on my Patreon.

Thank you for following the development progress. More updates will be posted here as work continues!
